intro: Professionals and everyday users convert acres (ac) to square feet (ft²) when working across imperial and imperial standards in real estate property deeds, agricultural land surveying, commercial floor plan leases, and civil zoning. One acre equals 43,560 square feet, while 1 square foot equals 0.000023 acres. Whether you are verifying area specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many square feet (ft²) are in 1 acre (ac)?
faqs.answer: There are 43,560 square feet (ft²) in 1 acre (ac), which rounds to 43,560 ft² for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 square foot equals 0.000023 acres.

faqs.question: How do I convert acres to square feet (ac to ft²)?
faqs.answer: To convert acres to square feet, use the formula: ft² = ac × 43,560. For example, converting 5 ac gives 217,800 ft².

faqs.question: What is 5 acres in square feet?
faqs.answer: 5 acres (ac) equals exactly 217,800 square feet (ft²) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
